source: Jolpica F1 API (https://api.jolpi.ca/ergast/f1/), Ergast-compatible historical results. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, non-commercial.
method: Podium (results/1, /2, /3) and final standings endpoints read for each season on the date above. Not the full classification: gaps are as the archive records them (winner: race time; P2 and P3: gap to the winner). Cross-checked: wins in the standings equal the number of race wins in the podium tables for every season.
